inv.desc_en:
REF: 7047454

InmoOlaya offers this profitable sale of a commercial property in Barcelona, in the Sant Andreu neighborhood.

Between Sant Andreu metro and a few meters from Av Meridiana, easy access to public transport, Metro Line 1, and buses.

Surrounded by homes, premises, and shops, it is located in a high-traffic and residential area.

It has 67 m² of usable space, street level, open plan, with 3 shop windows, 1 toilet.

Ceiling height of 3.15 meters, width - 3.35 m. No air conditioning.

12 linear meters of facade.

Price: €199,000

Rental price - €650 + VAT (5-year contract).
